name: Carmen del Darién (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and green, the light blue twice the height and charged with an arc of five white stars bearing the letters T U R E S.
history: Municipal flag of Carmen del Darién, a municipality in the department of Chocó, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: arc of five stars lettered T U R E S
